summary: @simaleerbg You got lyricist skills. Heard a lot of Talib Kweli influences too, especially in the cadence of your rhyming schemes on the four bar and the near rhymes in multi-syllabic words...Good stuff...Need it now...
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @simaleerbg You got lyricist skills. Heard a lot of Talib Kweli influences too, especially in the cadence of your rhyming schemes on the four bar and the near rhymes in multi-syllabic words...Good stuff...Need it now...
